data.exact_reserve_text: A surplus run-off amount of GBP 18.1m was experienced in 2017 (2016: GBP 8.6m deficit). This was made up of a surplus on the prior year claims provisions of GBP 22.5m on direct business (2016: GBP 14.1m deficit) and a GBP 4.4m deficit on reinsurance accepted business (2016: GBP 5.5m surplus).
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 22.5 million in 2017, primarily due to a surplus on direct business claims provisions. This was partially offset by a GBP 4.4 million deficit on reinsurance accepted business, resulting in a net run-off surplus of GBP 18.1 million.
raw_causal_phrases: surplus on the prior year claims provisions of GBP 22.5m on direct business
GBP 4.4m deficit on reinsurance accepted business

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The claims development triangle on page 25 does not explicitly show prior year development for the current reporting period in a way that can be directly summed for all prior years. The narrative on page 37 provides a net run-off figure and a gross direct business run-off figure, which is used for prior_year_development_gbp_m. The gross premium mix includes negative premiums for some lines of business, which is unusual but taken directly from the source.
